name: DaoCloud
note: Container platform vendor. Broad upstream coverage; upstream whitelists are adjusted without notice.

name: 1ms.run
note: Commercial acceleration service with a free public tier.

name: Nanjing University
note: University mirror service; usage policy is published on the mirror site. Requests from off-campus networks are refused (HTTP 403 as of 2026-09), which the probe reports as needing credentials.

name: SJTU Linux Users Group
note: Student-run mirror with a long track record.

name: USTC
note: The public Docker mirror was restricted to the university's own users and its domain no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN as of 2026-09). Kept listed so the history is explainable; leave it disabled.

name: Tencent Cloud (VPC only)
note: Reachable only from inside a Tencent Cloud VPC. Probing it from anywhere else will always fail, which is expected rather than a fault.

name: dockerproxy.com
note: Community-run proxy. Rate limits are not published.

name: hub.rat.dev
note: Little public information about the operator. It answers by redirecting to docker.1ms.run, so it behaves like that mirror and stands or falls with it. Listed because people use it, not because it is recommended.

name: NetEase
note: Plain HTTP only. Nothing in transit can be authenticated, so it is worth measuring but not worth trusting. Disabled by default.
